rule: state: UNVERIFIED (no evidence), FIXED (fixed in code, still to play or measure), VERIFIED (a run or a play proves it), FAILS. Changes only with evidence (commit, log, file or screenshot). Next task = the first row not VERIFIED; a row whose who names the OWNER waits for his verdict. Desde 2026-11-19 la tarea siguiente es la primera fila no VERIFIED del step 4 (Público); las filas de GATE50 siguen siendo el banco local y no bloquean publicar. `restarted` = una dirección que el OWNER reabrió, con su frase y fecha; `rejected` = una que sigue cerrada.
